column1: # OWASP ZAP Baseline Scan - Rule Configuration
# rule-id : the numeric ZAP alert/plugin ID for a given check
# action  : how the baseline scan should treat a match for this rule
#             WARN   - report the finding but do not fail the CI job
#             IGNORE - suppress the finding entirely (accepted risk / known false positive)
#             FAIL   - report the finding AND fail the CI job (build breaker)
# url-regex (optional): restrict the rule to URLs matching this pattern
# Any rule ID not listed here uses ZAP's default baseline behavior (WARN).
# Example entries (tune these for your own authorized target):
# 10096: Timestamp Disclosure - suppressed as a known low-risk false positive
#        on Juice Shop's static asset build timestamps.
# 40012: Cross Site Scripting (Reflected) - treated as a hard failure so any
#        regression is caught immediately in CI rather than just logged.
# 10202: Absence of Anti-CSRF Tokens - flagged for manual review but does not
#        block the pipeline on its own.
